name: MonarchDecisionCard
title: DecisionCard
wrapsNative: MonarchCard over androidx.compose.material3.Surface, with MonarchRadioRow (androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton), MonarchTextField (androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField), MonarchButton and MonarchBadge
summary: A card that records a decision about an item and the reason for it, next to the evidence, with who decided when and a read-only view.
whenToUse: When people choose what happens to an item and others need to see why: keep, review or let a domain lapse; approve, defer or reject a request.
whenNotToUse: For a simple setting use MonarchSwitchRow or MonarchRadioRow. For an approval that moves through several people use an approval flow.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDecisionCard(options: List<MonarchDecisionOption>, value: String?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, reason: String? = null, decidedAt: Long? = null, decidedBy: String? = null, allowNone: Boolean = true, reasonRequired: Boolean = false, readOnly: Boolean = false, saving: Boolean = false, errorText: String? = null, reasonLimit: Int = 500, labels: MonarchDecisionCardLabels = MonarchDecisionCardLabels(), onDecide: ((MonarchDecision) -> Unit)? = null, context: (@Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchDecisionOption(label: String, value: String, description: String? = null, note: String? = null, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, reasonRequired: Boolean? = null, enabled: Boolean = true)
class MonarchDecision(value: String?, reason: String? = null)

class MonarchDecisionCardLabels(choices: String? = null, none: String? = null, reason: String? = null, optional: String? = null, reasonPlaceholder: String? = null, reasonRequired: String? = null, charactersLeft: ((Int) -> String)? = null, save: String? = null, saved: String? = null, decided: String? = null, decidedBy: ((String) -> String)? = null, undecided: String? = null)

options.name: options
options.description: The choices, in order: label, value, and optionally a description, a note shown while selected, a badge tone, its own reason rule and whether it is enabled.

options.name: value
options.description: The saved decision, or null for none.

options.name: decidedAt
options.description: When the saved decision was made, in epoch milliseconds (UTC). Shown as a relative time.

options.name: allowNone
options.description: Offers a "No decision" choice that clears the decision.

options.name: reasonRequired
options.description: Every choice needs a reason; an option's own reasonRequired overrides it.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Shows the decision as a badge with the reason, without the form.

options.name: saving
options.description: The app is storing the decision: the form is disabled and the button shows progress.

options.name: errorText
options.description: Why the last save failed, shown in a danger banner.

options.name: reasonLimit
options.description: The longest reason accepted, in characters.

options.name: onDecide
options.description: Receives the decision to save. Without it the card is read-only.

options.name: context
options.description: Evidence for the decision, shown above the choices.

states.name: unchanged
states.description: The Save button is disabled while the form equals the saved decision.

states.name: selected choice
states.description: The radio button of the choice is selected; its note is shown under the choices.

states.name: reason missing
states.description: After Save is activated without a required reason, the field is in the error state with a message.

states.name: near the limit
states.description: From 50 characters left, the number left is shown under the reason.

states.name: saving
states.description: The choices and the reason are disabled and the button shows progress.

states.name: saved
states.description: "Decision saved." is shown under the time until the next edit.

states.name: failed
states.description: The choice and the reason are kept and the error is shown in a danger banner.

states.name: read-only
states.description: A badge in the option's tone, or "No decision yet", then the reason and who decided when.

appearance: A MonarchCard with the group name, notes, time and saved message in the muted text color. The choices are Material 3 radio buttons, the reason an outlined text field and Save a primary button; the read-only decision is a subtle badge in the option's tone. Colors come from these components' roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web card uses radio inputs and a Textarea and calls onDecide, which may return a promise. Android draws the choices as a row of selectable tiles with MonarchRadioCardGroup in its Tile layout, as the web does, where iOS draws button rows with a checkmark. Saving is hoisted, as Compose state is: onDecide receives the decision and the app sets saving and then the new value, or errorText, instead of an async function that throws. The web headingLevel, now and locale properties have no counterpart: the title is a heading, and the time uses the user's locale and is redrawn every minute. The built-in "characters left" text is a plurals resource.
accessibility: Each choice is one TalkBack element with the radio button role, read as its label and description, inside a selectable group with the visible name "Decision".
Selection is the radio mark as well as a color.
The note of the selected choice is a polite live region, so a newly selected choice's note is announced.
A missing reason puts the field in the error state, which TalkBack reads with the message.
The saved message and the error banner are polite live regions.
The time of the decision is shown as a relative time and read as an absolute date and time.
Every choice and the Save button have 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: A new value or reason from the app resets the form.
A reason of white space only counts as empty, and the reason is trimmed before it is passed to onDecide.
Text beyond reasonLimit is cut as it is typed or pasted.
With allowNone false and no saved value, no choice is selected and Save stays disabled until one is chosen.
The empty saved-message line keeps its height so the live region is always present.

examples.title: Renewal decision with evidence
Read-only, for people who cannot change it
examples.code:
MonarchDecisionCard(
    options = listOf(MonarchDecisionOption(label = "Keep", value = "keep", tone = MonarchTone.Success)),
    value = "keep",
    reason = "Still in use by the support team.",
    decidedBy = "Ana",
    readOnly = true,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web shows the four decisions in one row of 120px tiles and Reason optional with a muted word after the label. The phone window is 344dp wide, so the four tiles do not fit on one line: three share the first line and No decision wraps onto a second; the Reason label reads Reason (optional) in one style, as the field's label, and the textarea text starts at its top as on the web. The title, usage line, tiles, reason, Decided line and Save decision are the web's.
parityExceptions.convention: Material 3 selectable tiles, one row of four at most
